description: Validate that child execution inherits only explicit namespace and Host Mount authority.
command: cargo test -p alan-agent-engine process_launch::tests::child_inherits_a_snapshot_without_gaining_mounts --lib -- --exact && cargo test -p alan-agent-engine tools::registry::tests::approved_host_mount_updates_path_projection_and_sandbox_together --lib -- --exact
assertions: child launch cannot gain a Host Mount that the parent did not pass
approved Host Mount projection updates namespace and native sandbox authority together
cwd remains an Alan OS namespace path
